sources.title: Digital Realty files to expand planned data center campus in Garland, Texas
Digital Realty DFW37, 1505 Ferris Road, Garland

profile.capacity_note: Individual per-building critical IT MW not confirmed from a tier-1 source in this pass.
profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: two OSM nodes for this campus sit ~230m apart (way/1530197817 and way/1525436762); Nominatim resolves both to the same nearest tagged building (1505 Ferris Road). Trade press (DCD, Hoodline, WFAA) confirms an active multi-building Digital Realty campus here (DFW37 built, DFW40 ~280,000 sqft underway per a 2025 TDLR permit). Address/campus seeded for both nodes; specific per-building facility codes not assigned since which node is which building could not be confirmed.
sources_tried: The operators own Dallas portfolio page listing 12 facilities, seven of which cluster within about a mile of this rows coordinates in Richardson, TX, no address is asserted given the unresolved ambiguity among at least seven candidates
profile.facility_type_note: Part of Digital Realty's Dallas-Fort Worth campus, concentrated in Richardson, TX (DFW airport code used in Digital Realty's naming). Confirmed addresses per Digital Realty's own site include DFW17 at 900 Quality Way, DFW18 at 1210 Integrity Drive, and DFW35 at 907 Security Row, all Richardson.
